equipment.name: Auspex scanner
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit gain the "Acute Senses" ability.

equipment.name: Bionics
equipment.desc: The model gains Ward(6+).

equipment.name: Heavy armor
equipment.desc: The model gains a 4+ armor save.

equipment.name: Heirloom
equipment.desc:
One weapon of the model gains one of the following:
- Additional +6" Range (only for ranged weapons)
- Additional +1 Strength
- Additional -1 AP
- Additional +1 AT
Every enhancement is unique per army. Can be taken multiple times.

equipment.name: Household banner
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit gain +1 Leadership.

equipment.name: Instrument
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit may reroll Leadership tests during the Rally phase.

equipment.name: Light armor
equipment.desc: The model gains a 5+ armor save.

equipment.name: Marksman honours
equipment.desc: The model gains +1 Ballistic skill.

equipment.name: Master-crafted armor
equipment.desc: The model gains a 2+ armor save.

equipment.name: Master-crafted weapon
equipment.desc: The model may re-roll one to hit roll per activation. Must be purchased for each weapon seperately.

equipment.name: Mechanical steed
equipment.desc: The model gains +6" Movement, +1 Strength +1 Toughness, +1 Wound, +1 Attack and the type "Bike". For infantry only.

equipment.name: Psychic training
equipment.desc: The model knows one additional psychic power from one of their chosen psychic disciplines. If it already knows all powers from each discipline, it may instead learn one power from a new discipline it has access to. Can be taken multiple times.

equipment.name: Purity seal
equipment.desc: Enemy psykers suffer a -1 penalty to manifest a power when they target the model or its attached unit.

equipment.name: Refractor field
equipment.desc: The model gains Ward(5+)

equipment.name: Shield
equipment.desc: The model gains the abilities "Deflect" and "Parry".

equipment.name: Swordsman honours
equipment.desc: The model gains +1 Weapon skill.

equipment.name: Teleport homing beacon
equipment.desc: A friendly unit arriving via Deep Strike within 3" of the bearer does not scatter. Can only be used if the bearer was on the battlefield at the start of the battle round and has not moved more than 12" during that battle round yet.

equipment.name: Trophy
equipment.desc: The model gains a cumulative instance of the "Terrifying(-1)" ability.

equipment.name: Adamantium Knight
equipment.desc: The model gains +1 Armor Value on all sides.

equipment.name: Blessed by the Sacristans
equipment.desc: One weapon of the model gains the "Soul Burn(5+)" ability.

equipment.name: Champion of the Household
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Frenzy(2")" ability.

equipment.name: Cold-blooded
equipment.desc: The model gains +1 to hit rolls against enemy units with at least 1 Battleshock token.

equipment.name: Cunning Commander
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Ouflank" and "Vanguard" abilities.

equipment.name: First Knight
equipment.desc: The model may reroll hit rolls of 1.

equipment.name: Glooming Legacy
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Deflect" ability.

equipment.name: Indomitable
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Parry" ability.

equipment.name: Knight of Mars
equipment.desc: All ranged weapons of the model gain the "Rending(5+)" ability.

equipment.name: Last of Their Line
equipment.desc: The model gains +1 Attack and another +1 for each missing Hull Point.

equipment.name: Legendary Hero
equipment.desc: During each activation, you may remove one Battleshock token from each unit in your army.

equipment.name: Master of the Joust
equipment.desc: The model resolves Tank Shock attacks at Strength 10.

equipment.name: Master of the Trial
equipment.desc: Enemy attacks reduce their AT by 1 (to a minimum of 0) against this model.

equipment.name: Paragon
equipment.desc: The model gains +1 Hull Point.

equipment.name: Peerless Warrior
equipment.desc: The model may re-roll one of each: Armor penetration roll, Hit roll, Wound roll.

equipment.name: Revered Knight
equipment.desc: The model gains +1 Initiative.

equipment.name: Sworn to Quest
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Objective Secured!" ability.

equipment.name: Tireless
equipment.desc: The model may make a 6" consolidation move after melee combat.

equipment.name: Wyrd
equipment.desc: The model becomes a psyker and can manifest 1 power per activation. It knows one Witchfire from a chosen discipline.

equipment.name: Additional armor
equipment.desc: The model ignores the first "Crew Shaken" vehicle damage each round.

equipment.name: Blessed Autosimulacra
equipment.desc: The model repairs one vehicle damage at the start of each Reinforcement phase in any order.

equipment.name: Hunter-killer missile
equipment.desc: The model gains a Hunter-killer missile.

equipment.name: Imperial Banner
equipment.desc: All friendly units within 12" must reroll failed Leadership tests.

equipment.name: Improved targeting
equipment.desc: The model does not have to declare its ranged weapons at all targets before firing, and can choose a new target for each weapon.

equipment.name: Ion Bulwark
equipment.desc: The model gains the "Warded" ability.

equipment.name: Jammer
equipment.desc: Equipment such as Icons or Teleport homing beacons do not function within 12" of the model. Additionally, units arriving via Deep Strike that land within 12" roll an additional 2D6 for scattering.

equipment.name: Machine spirit
equipment.desc: If the model is under the effect of "Crew shaken", it may use one weapon at BS 3+.

equipment.name: Purity seal
equipment.desc: Enemy psykers suffer a -1 to manifestation rolls if they target the model or its attached unit directly.

equipment.name: Relic heirloom
equipment.desc:
One weapon of the model gains one of the following:
- Additional +6" Range (only for ranged weapons)
- Additional +1 Strength
- Additional -1 AP
- Additional +1 AT
Every enhancement is unique per army. Can be taken multiple times.

equipment.name: Sanctuary Shield
equipment.desc: The model's ward saves works in melee and ranged combat.

equipment.name: Smoke Launcher
equipment.desc:
The model can use its Smoke Launcher once per game:
- During normal activation, instead of firing weapons.
- If it has not yet carried out its order this round and is targeted by an enemy unit. The order is consumed by doing so.
Enemy units can only deal glancing hits with ranged attacks until the next activation.
